directAnswer: USB-C is a connector type, while Thunderbolt is a protocol that can use the USB-C connector for high-speed data transfer and video output.
summary: Understanding the distinction between USB-C and Thunderbolt can help users maximize their device capabilities and compatibility.

sections.heading: USB-C Connector
sections.body: USB-C is a universal connector that supports various protocols, including USB 3.1, USB 3.2, and USB Power Delivery. It allows for reversible plug orientation and can deliver power up to 100W.

sections.heading: Thunderbolt Technology
sections.body: Thunderbolt, developed by Intel, supports data transfer speeds up to 40 Gbps and can daisy-chain multiple devices. Thunderbolt 3 and 4 use the USB-C connector but offer additional features like support for multiple 4K displays.

sections.heading: Compatibility
sections.body: While all Thunderbolt ports are USB-C compatible, not all USB-C ports support Thunderbolt. Check device specifications to ensure compatibility.

steps.title: Check Device Specifications
steps.detail: To determine if your USB-C port supports Thunderbolt, refer to the manufacturer's documentation or the device's technical specifications.

steps.title: Identify Cable Type
steps.detail: Use a Thunderbolt-certified cable for optimal performance. USB-C cables may not support Thunderbolt speeds.

faqs.question: Can I use a USB-C charger with a Thunderbolt device?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can use a USB-C charger with a Thunderbolt device, but charging speed may vary based on the charger’s wattage.

faqs.question: What devices typically use Thunderbolt?
faqs.answer: Thunderbolt is commonly found in high-performance laptops, external GPUs, and docking stations.

faqs.question: Are there different versions of Thunderbolt?
faqs.answer: Yes, there are several versions of Thunderbolt, with Thunderbolt 3 and 4 being the most widely used, both utilizing the USB-C connector.

caveats: Not all USB-C ports support Thunderbolt, so it's important to verify compatibility before purchasing accessories.
